title: Mara and the Verdict
author: Lior Voss
blurb: Zephyrine Vasquez, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
